name: Jason Felling
caption: The Sooner Wrestling Council's co-president, billed as "Vgilante" Jason Felling in the promotion's own founding handbook.

tenures.source: The federation's own founding handbook, 12 January 1999, naming him Co-President.

name: Tim Beck
caption: An early Sooner Wrestling Council signee who cut a boastful promo naming several fellow wrestlers ahead of the promotion's own January 1999 debut card.

tenures.source: The federation's own founding handbook (12 January 1999) and roleplay newsletter (26 January 1999).
Billed in the promotion's own 27 June 1999 return announcement as its Icon Heavyweight Champion, unbeaten since an elimination gauntlet that March.

name: Alex Cote
caption: A Sooner Wrestling Council wrestler who promised to win the promotion's own debut Royal Rumble and its Heavyweight title.

tenures.source: The federation's own founding handbook (12 January 1999) and roleplay newsletters (26 and 29 January 1999).

identity.note: A different wrestler carries this name in another promotion's own record, which names a different prior federation than this document does; nothing links the two.

name: Aaron Anderson
caption: A Sooner Wrestling Council wrestler introduced with an evolution-themed debut promo; the promotion's own documents spell his surname two ways.

tenures.source: The federation's own founding handbook (12 January 1999) and roleplay newsletters (26 and 29 January 1999).

name: The Trixxster
caption: A masked Sooner Wrestling Council heel billed as a past year-end best-heel award winner ahead of the promotion's own debut card.

tenures.source: The federation's own founding handbook (12 January 1999) and roleplay newsletter (29 January 1999).

identity.note: A newsgroup year-end poll stub carries this same name tagged to a different federation than this document names; nothing links the two.

name: V.D. Vitrone
caption: A Sooner Wrestling Council wrestler featured in the promotion's own pre-debut roleplay newsletter and named among its debut Royal Rumble entrants.

tenures.source: The federation's own founding handbook (12 January 1999) and roleplay newsletter (29 January 1999).

identity.note: A different wrestler carries this exact name in another promotion's own record; nothing links the two beyond the name.
